name: Special Joint City Council & SDWD Meeting- 5:30 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Joint City Council & SDWD Meeting- 5:30 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 29, 2021 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
City Council: Mayor Blakespear, Deputy Mayor Kranz, Council Member Hinze, Council Member Lyndes, Council Member Mosca
San Dieguito Water District: President Kranz, Vice President Blakespear, Board Member Hinze, Board Member Lyndes, and Board Member Mosca
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
2.
AGENDA ITEMS
2A.
Adopt Resolutions to approve the COVID-19 Pandemic Vaccination (Wellness Incentive Program) for SEIU and unrepresented permanent employees of the City of Encinitas and San Dieguito Water District. Contact Person: Human Resources Director Bokosky
1) City of Encinitas City Council adopt Resolution 2021-96 approving a COVID-19 Pandemic Vaccination (Wellness Incentive) Program for SEIU and unrepresented permanent employees; and 2) San Dieguito Water District Board adopt Resolution 2021-20 approving a COVID-19 Pandemic Vaccination (Wellness Incentive) Program for SEIU and unrepresented permanent employees.
2021-09-29 Special Meeting Item 02A Wellness Incentive Program
3.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
